suiteName: UKG Commons Demo — Save News Articles (Functional)

case.title: Unsaving an item removes it immediately from the Saved News list and reflects in feed

steps.targetDescription: Scroll to the target article card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Save the article (ensure it is in Saved News)
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark']

steps.targetDescription: Verify saved (filled) icon on the card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark--filled']

steps.targetDescription: Confirm the item is in the Saved list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Tap to unsave within the Saved list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark--filled']

steps.targetDescription: Verify the item is removed from Saved News immediately
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Go back to homepage to validate feed state
Verify the article card shows unsaved (outline) bookmark
